title: SDE Intern
description:
Worked on an agentic AI analytics service that answers natural-language questions by breaking them into backend tool calls.
Built the tools to resolve identity, define and rank templates, execute queries and ask clarifying questions, cutting model token usage by ~24%.
Created template queries for popular questions, separating them from free-form LLM workflows that use schema-backed generation.
Added features around the SDK layer, including streamed responses, inline charts, saved conversations, voice input/output and follow-up prompts.

title: Software Developer Intern
description:
Engineered and deployed the new corporate website using React.js and Next.js for Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
Developed a full-stack blogging platform, designing a PostgreSQL schema in Supabase and building REST APIs.
Architected a maintainable, component-driven frontend system with Tailwind CSS for a consistent user experience.

title: Summer Intern
description:
Designed and developed a responsive Next.js website as the frontend interface for the Quant teams' predictive model.
Integrated smooth user interactions using Framer Motion to enhance UX with the goal of improving user retention.

title: Summer Intern
description:

Gained proficiency in JavaScript and React, applying these skills to create an intuitive and seamless user interface.
